item.title: Miyazaki Beef: Champion Wagyu — Guide
item.description: Miyazaki beef (Miyazaki-gyu) is one of Japan’s most acclaimed brands of wagyu — famously crowned the nation’s best at the prestigious ‘Wagyu Olympics’ national competition multiple times, a source of enormous local pride. Raised to strict standards from black-haired Japanese cattle in Miyazaki’s warm, green countryside, this premium beef is renowned for its exquisite fine marbling, deep umami flavour and remarkable tenderness. The fat melts at a low temperature, giving a rich, buttery, melt-in-the-mouth texture and a sweet, lingering taste that ranks it among the very finest beef in the country.
